implementation.commitment: Synchronous in-memory complete fine pair; no coarse, rejected or incomplete work committed. Trial endpoint states/digests and initial state retained. Legacy journals and per-step callbacks reject before solving.
implementation.controls: Original global fractions and knots; no trial reuse or coarsening. Deep detached states/records; Python model/control snapshots plus exposed native parameters, excluding intended contact caches.
implementation.defaultCompatibility: Omitted/None policy follows the prior adaptive loop. Default energy reports receive no temporal fields. No protected capture/replay entrypoint changes.
implementation.depthAndTime: max_depth includes deepest evaluated fine half; initial-grid exponent plus depth <=40. Exact binary64 interval duration must equal the requested physical duration times its original-fraction length; underflow/nonrepresentability rejects.
implementation.energyDecision: For each fine interval, abs(exact stored kinetic change + exact sum of eight numerical fixed-motion terms) + matching cable motion radius <= B_E times exact original fraction length. No cancellation between halves; exact prefix sum.
implementation.failureScope: Handled runtime/resource failures return prior committed prefix. Propagated interrupts carry temporal_result with matching declared context and accepted work totals. Hard process termination/OOM cannot promise allocation of an exception report.
order: second half from detached first-half endpoint
implementation.preflight: Existing cable finite-grid preflight covers full depth; knot and nearest finest-grid neighbor checks retain positive sewing activation and fold/gripper activation/effective-coefficient admission.
